moments.title: Bank Holiday Weekend Arrives
moments.blurb: The Summer Bank Holiday for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland falls on Monday, August 31, bringing a long weekend to most of the UK.

angles.name: General Buzz
angles.copy: That Bank Holiday feeling is officially kicking in! Who's ready for an extra day off? Three-day weekend, let's go! #BankHoliday

angles.name: Travel Prep
angles.copy: Getting away this Bank Holiday weekend? Expect busy roads and rail disruption on some routes. Plan your journey ahead!

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festival Kicks Off
moments.blurb: Reading & Leeds Festival runs from Thursday, August 27 to Sunday, August 30, with headliners including Charli XCX, Dave, Florence + The Machine, Fontaines D.C., Chase & Status Live, and Raye.

angles.name: Festival Excitement
angles.copy: Reading & Leeds is HERE! Who are you most buzzing to see on stage this weekend? Let the festival vibes commence! #RandL26

angles.name: Headliner Spotlight
angles.copy: From Charli XCX to Florence + The Machine and Dave, the Reading & Leeds line-up is stacked! Who's bringing the biggest crowd this year?

moments.title: Creamfields Returns to Daresbury
moments.blurb: Creamfields, one of the UK's biggest electronic dance music festivals, takes place from Thursday, August 27 to Sunday, August 30, in Daresbury, Cheshire, featuring acts like Calvin Harris, Swedish House Mafia, and Tiësto.

angles.name: Dance Festival Kicks Off
angles.copy: Creamfields is back! The beats drop this Thursday in Daresbury. Who's heading to Cheshire for a weekend of world-class DJs and epic sets? #Creamfields2026

angles.name: Lineup Hype
angles.copy: Calvin Harris, Swedish House Mafia, Tiësto... the Creamfields line-up is absolutely huge! Get ready to rave!

moments.title: Premier League Weekend Action
moments.blurb: The Premier League season continues with Matchweek 2 and 3 fixtures across the Bank Holiday weekend, including Liverpool vs. Nottingham Forest on Saturday and Manchester United vs. Ipswich Town on Sunday.

angles.name: Weekend Fixtures
angles.copy: Premier League action heats up this Bank Holiday weekend! What's your match of the weekend? Saturday sees Liverpool face Nottingham Forest.

angles.name: Team Focus
angles.copy: Big Sunday for some teams! Manchester United host Ipswich Town, while Chelsea take on Brighton. Who's picking up crucial early points?

moments.title: Great British Bake Off Teasers
moments.blurb: Channel 4 is teasing the return of The Great British Bake Off, with new judge Nigella Lawson joining Paul Hollywood, Alison Hammond, and Noel Fielding, expected to air on September 29.

angles.name: Bake Off Hype
angles.copy: On your marks, get set... BAKE! The Great British Bake Off is returning to our screens on September 29, with Nigella Lawson joining the judging panel!

angles.name: New Judge Reaction
angles.copy: Nigella Lawson in the Bake Off tent? That's a recipe for success! What are your thoughts on the new judging line-up?

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean Hold UK No.1
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' remains at number one on the Official UK Singles Chart for the week of August 21-27, extending its record-breaking run to 22 non-consecutive weeks.

angles.name: Chart Domination
angles.copy: Still number one! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' makes it a staggering 22 non-consecutive weeks at the top of the Official Singles Chart. Is it the song of the year?

angles.name: Record Breaker
angles.copy: History made! 'Rein Me In' is now the longest-running UK Number 1 single of all time. An incredible achievement for Sam Fender and Olivia Dean!
